messages:
tom_sales: New RFP from Borealis asking for on-prem HSM (they mentioned Thales), POC runbook, and a side-by-side pricing table for Dedicated vs Private. Need quick turnaround: Friday COB.

ivy_se: I can draft a lean POC runbook: acceptance criteria, minimal infra diagram, test prompts, and key ops tests. Need to know whether keys must be non-exportable.

chris_ops: They specified non-exportable keys + rotation API. For a 10-day POC at ~40 concurrent tokens/sec we estimate ~180 GPU-hours for Dedicated small pool. Private will be customer infra; ops integration 2-3 days. I'll prep numbers.

amy_research: I'll create a capability matrix focusing on HSM connector support, quantization options, KV cache persistence, and latency expectations per model family. Will note any Thales caveats.

sec_bot: Security Q4: We accept customer HSMs via PKCS#11/KMIP; attestation and SOC2 excerpts are available under NDA. Standard blurb ready.

nora_cs: I'll package runbook + capability CSV + cost calc for portal upload. Who owns final assembly?

tom_sales: Ivy owns runbook + tests, Chris owns cost calc, Amy owns capability matrix, Nora uploads. Legal/security will supply final wording for the HSM attestation.

ivy_se: sample acceptance tests I'll include: mutual TLS handshake, create key on HSM, verify non-exportability (wrap attempt fails), rotate key via API and verify signatures, inference correctness on 8 prompts, 95th percentile latency <300ms for 256 tokens.

chris_ops: uploaded cost calc: https://files.redwood.internal/attachments/borealis-poc-1765556666.csv (perm: sales,ops).

tom_sales: timeline: Thurs AM drafts, Thurs PM internal review, Fri AM final bundle, Fri COB submit. Flag any blockers ASAP.

sec_bot: Noted risk: attestation docs may require NDA; recommend provisional language in RFP stating details provided under NDA.

nora_cs: Adding calendar invite for kickoff Mon 09:00 if they accept.

(END)
